from scipy.optimize import least_squares
eps=df['eps'];T=df['T'];s=df['sigma']
def fit(model, p0, n=3):
    best=None
    rng=np.random.default_rng(2)
    for k in range(n):
        p=np.array(p0,float)*(1+0.5*rng.standard_normal(len(p0))) if k else np.array(p0,float)
        def f(q):
            r=model(q)-s
            return np.where(np.isfinite(r),r,1e3)
        r=least_squares(f, p, max_nfev=400)
        if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
    return 1-2*best.cost/np.sum((s-s.mean())**2), best.x
